notes.title: THE ALERT! UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h1][b]HAPPY NEW YEAR SAILORS![/b] [/h1]
A fresh update has been released for [b]The Mutineer![/b] In this update we took a look at player feedback and have added some requested features that will help improve the quality of life for all players!
New visual additions include:
[list]
[*] Added a visual notification for when the Mutineer [u][b]sabotages[/b][/u] an engine.
[*] Added animated notification for when engineers are [u][b]repairing[/b][/u] a sabotaged engine.
[/list]
We hope that these new visual notifications, in addition to the original sound cues, should make The Mutineer a more straightforward, enjoyable experience for you and your friends.

Thank you for all your support in 2020, please let us know what you think!

Happy New Year, The NOTH Team.
